hostPorts.purpose: Validates exact Catalog Product selections before they enter a Saved List without Collections reading Catalog tables.

saved-lists.purpose: The saved-lists slice owns the event-sourced Saved List lifecycle, exact Product membership, tracked quantity, private line metadata, deterministic ordering, visibility state, cover selection, and versioned command/event contracts.
expectedConsumers: Saved List projection, valuation, sharing, Inventory handoff, sell-through, and My Collection slices

runtime-support.purpose: Provide the Collections event-store schema and runtime service composition seam without taking Saved List behavior out of its slice.

routes.purpose: Compose the My Collection deep-module route for marketplace-web from Collections Saved List reads and Inventory-owned Overview and Owned Cards.

ui-support.purpose: Hold the React My Collection deep module for the collections context, its Overview, Owned Cards, and saved-lists sections, and their presentation view-models exported through ./web.

request-support.purpose: Provide the request-scoped Collections API client that the My Collection route uses to reach Saved List reads and commands over HTTP.
